# @cfast/forms

> Auto-generated forms from your Drizzle schema. Customize what you need, accept defaults for the rest.

## When to use
Use this package when you have a Drizzle SQLite table and want a working form without manually wiring up inputs, validation, and labels. Supports both create and edit modes, progressive field customization, and pluggable UI libraries.

## Key concepts
- **Schema-driven**: Your Drizzle table is the source of truth. Column types map to input types, nullability maps to required/optional, enums map to selects.
- **Progressive customization**: Start with `<AutoForm table={posts} mode="create" />`. Override individual fields incrementally -- labels, components, visibility, validation -- without rewriting the form.
- **Headless core + UI plugins**: The core (`introspectTable`, `createResolver`, `createAutoForm`) is UI-agnostic. Rendering is delegated to a plugin. Ships with MUI Joy UI (`@cfast/forms/joy`).
- **Validation via `v()`**: Attach validation rules directly to Drizzle column builders. The rules are stored as metadata and read back during introspection.
- **Parent-child forms**: Declare child tables via the `children` prop — each becomes a `useFieldArray` with add / remove / reorder controls, full schema-derived validation, and `minRows` / `maxRows` constraints. See the "Parent-child tables" section below.

## API Reference

### Core (`@cfast/forms`)

```typescript
// Introspect a Drizzle table into field definitions
function introspectTable(table: SQLiteTable): FieldDefinition[];

// Build a react-hook-form resolver from field definitions
function createResolver(
  fields: FieldDefinition[],
  fieldOverrides?: Partial<Record<string, FieldConfig>>
): Resolver<FieldValues>;

// Attach validation rules to a Drizzle column builder
function v<T extends ColumnBuilderBase>(builder: T, rules: ValidationRules): T;

// Register UI components as a plugin
function createFormPlugin(config: { components: FormPluginComponents }): FormPlugin;

// Create an AutoForm component from a plugin
function createAutoForm(plugin: FormPlugin): React.ComponentType<AutoFormProps>;

type FieldDefinition = {
  name: string;           // column key
  inputType: InputType;   // "text" | "number" | "checkbox" | "select"
  label: string;          // auto-generated from column name
  required: boolean;      // from NOT NULL
  hasDefault: boolean;
  isPrimaryKey: boolean;
  enumValues?: string[];
  validation: ValidationRules;
};

type ValidationRules = {
  minLength?: number;
  maxLength?: number;
  min?: number;
  max?: number;
  pattern?: RegExp;
  message?: string;  // custom error message override
};

type FieldConfig = {
  label?: string;
  placeholder?: string;
  hidden?: boolean;
  default?: unknown;
  component?: React.ComponentType<FieldComponentProps>;
  validate?: (value: unknown) => string | undefined;
  readOnly?: boolean;
};

type ChildTableConfig = {
  table: SQLiteTable;              // Drizzle table for each row
  foreignKey: string;              // parent-pointing column, excluded from the child UI
  minRows?: number;                // default 0; enforced on submit
  maxRows?: number;                // default unlimited; enforced on submit
  reorderable?: boolean;           // show move-up / move-down buttons
  fields?: Partial<Record<string, FieldConfig>>;  // per-column overrides
  exclude?: string[];              // extra columns to omit from the row UI
  label?: string;                  // heading override
  addLabel?: string;               // "Add row" button override
};

type FieldComponentProps = {
  name: string;
  label: string;
  placeholder?: string;
  required: boolean;
  readOnly?: boolean;
  error?: string;
  enumValues?: string[];
  register: UseFormRegister<FieldValues>;
};

type FormPluginComponents = {
  textInput: React.ComponentType<FieldComponentProps>;
  numberInput: React.ComponentType<FieldComponentProps>;
  select: React.ComponentType<FieldComponentProps>;
  checkbox: React.ComponentType<FieldComponentProps>;
  form: React.ComponentType<FormWrapperProps>;
  submitButton: React.ComponentType<SubmitButtonProps>;
  // Optional. If omitted, `DefaultChildTable` is used.
  childTable?: React.ComponentType<ChildTableComponentProps>;
};

type InputType = "text" | "number" | "checkbox" | "select";
```

### AutoForm Props

```typescript
type AutoFormProps = {
  table: SQLiteTable;                              // Drizzle table to generate from
  mode: "create" | "edit";                         // create = empty, edit = pre-filled
  data?: Record<string, unknown>;                  // existing data for edit mode
  onSubmit: (values: Record<string, unknown>) => void | Promise<void>;
  fields?: Partial<Record<string, FieldConfig>>;   // per-field overrides
  children?: Record<string, ChildTableConfig>;     // parent-child dynamic field arrays
  exclude?: string[];                              // columns to omit
  form?: UseFormReturn<Record<string, unknown>>;   // external RHF instance
};
```

### Joy UI Plugin (`@cfast/forms/joy`)

```typescript
import { AutoForm } from "@cfast/forms/joy";
// Pre-built AutoForm using MUI Joy UI components. Ready to use.
```

## Usage Examples

### Minimal create form
```typescript
import { AutoForm } from "@cfast/forms/joy";
import { posts } from "./schema";

function CreatePost() {
  return <AutoForm table={posts} mode="create" onSubmit={handleSubmit} />;
}
```

### Edit form with customizations
```typescript
<AutoForm
  table={posts}
  mode="edit"
  data={existingPost}
  fields={{
    title: { label: "Post Title", placeholder: "Enter a title..." },
    content: { component: RichTextEditor },
    authorId: { hidden: true, default: currentUser.id },
  }}
  exclude={["createdAt", "updatedAt"]}
  onSubmit={handleSubmit}
/>
```

### Schema-level validation with `v()`
```typescript
import { v } from "@cfast/forms";
import { sqliteTable, text, integer } from "drizzle-orm/sqlite-core";

export const posts = sqliteTable("posts", {
  title: v(text("title").notNull(), { minLength: 3, maxLength: 200 }),
  views: v(integer("views"), { min: 0 }),
  slug: v(text("slug").notNull(), { pattern: /^[a-z0-9-]+$/ }),
  content: text("content").notNull(),
});
```

### Parent-child tables (dynamic field arrays)
```typescript
import { AutoForm } from "@cfast/forms/joy";
import { recipes, ingredients } from "./schema";

<AutoForm
  table={recipes}
  mode="create"
  exclude={["id"]}
  children={{
    ingredients: {
      table: ingredients,
      foreignKey: "recipe_id",  // column on ingredients pointing at recipes.id
      minRows: 1,
      maxRows: 50,
      reorderable: true,
      fields: {
        name: { placeholder: "Flour" },
        amount: { placeholder: "g" },
      },
    },
  }}
  onSubmit={async (values) => {
    // values.ingredients is the array of typed ingredient rows.
    // The foreign-key column is automatically excluded from the rendered
    // rows — the action layer stamps the parent id after creating the
    // parent row.
  }}
/>;
```

Each child entry is introspected like the parent: column types drive inputs,
NOT NULL drives `required`, enums become selects, and `v()` rules flow through.
The default child table renders add / remove / reorder buttons; plugins can
ship their own `childTable` component to match their design system
(`@cfast/forms/joy` includes one).

### Custom UI plugin
```typescript
import { createFormPlugin, createAutoForm } from "@cfast/forms";

const myPlugin = createFormPlugin({
  components: {
    textInput: MyTextInput,
    numberInput: MyNumberInput,
    select: MySelect,
    checkbox: MyCheckbox,
    form: MyFormWrapper,
    submitButton: MySubmitButton,
  },
});

export const AutoForm = createAutoForm(myPlugin);
```

## Column-to-input mapping
| Drizzle Column              | InputType    |
|-----------------------------|--------------|
| `text` / `varchar`          | `"text"`     |
| `integer`                   | `"number"`   |
| `integer({ mode: "boolean" })` | `"checkbox"` |
| `text({ enum: [...] })`    | `"select"`   |

## Integration
- **Drizzle ORM**: `introspectTable` reads column metadata via `getTableColumns`. The `v()` helper stores validation on column builder internals.
- **react-hook-form**: `createResolver` produces a RHF-compatible resolver. AutoForm uses `useForm` internally (or accepts an external instance).

## Common Mistakes
- Using `v()` on the built column instead of the builder: `v(text("title").notNull(), rules)` is correct. `v(text("title"), rules).notNull()` is also fine. But you cannot call `v()` after the table is created.
- Forgetting `mode="edit"` when passing `data` -- in create mode, `data` is ignored.
- Passing a `fields.validate` function that returns `undefined` on error instead of an error string. Return a string to indicate failure, `undefined` to pass.
- Excluding a required field without providing a default -- the form will fail validation since the field is NOT NULL but has no input.
- Forgetting to `exclude` the parent primary key when the child table points at it: the parent primary key is often auto-generated server-side, so add it to `exclude` on the parent form.
